loss: negative Pearson + frequency CE + distribution KL
input_crop: v1 static HC1.5 first frame, square/center fallback; torchvision float bilinear resize128 antialias
label_training: PURE timestamp interpolation; UBFC native frame-aligned BVP; clip diff/std
overlap: arithmetic mean of normalized derivative predictions at each common sample
coverage: unchanged existing journal complete160-frame chunks, from native frame0; no clip exclusion
tail: repeat final raw frame only when common interval ends at exact decoded length
test_gt: byte-identical verified journal cached labels; never averaged or timestamp-realigned
best: Epoch30 fixed before training; no best search
variant_selection: direct fixed before this run; no test selection
split_policy: Explicit subject-disjoint train30/test12 membership in splits; use the same fixed lists for all models.
subject37_coverage: Native decoded 1170/2032 metadata frames; 7 training clips using 1121 raw frames, no waveform stretching
